name: Iceland University of the Arts
summary: Arts university in Reykjavík with about 600 students; one BA is taught in English, Contemporary Dance Practices, chosen by videos and audition.

handoff.label: Contemporary Dance Practices BA, taught in English

ib.text: LHÍ does not name the IB: it asks for a matriculation exam or a comparable foreign school-leaving exam. Selection is by videos, audition and interview; EU/EEA applicants' English is judged at interview.

dates.label: Application deadline, with cover letter and two videos
Step 1 results emailed by this date
Online group assessment (step 2 assignments due before 17 Feb)
In-person group assessment in Reykjavík; interviews 20–21 Feb
Committee results emailed before this date
Confirm your place by paying the registration fee, before this date

programmes.name: Contemporary Dance Practices BA
programmes.ib: Two dance videos with the application, then an online or in-person group assessment and interview. Prior dance education at upper-secondary level is preferred.

notes: Other LHÍ bachelor's are taught mainly in Icelandic; the pages for acting, film, fashion, product design and visual communication say so.
The fifth semester is spent on an international exchange or a professional internship with an artist or company.
The application fee is ISK 5,000; it is not refunded and not deducted from the registration fee.
